title: The normalized square reaches the raw target endpoint
statement: With f:X→S, k:Z→T, g:T→S, v:Z→X and vf=kg, let G be a module sheaf on Z, J an injective resolution, q a natural number and V an open of S. The direct-image section unit for f, followed by the derived unit for v and the right-adjoint derived square comparison, then topEdgeLocalLeray for g and squareInverseOpenComparison for g, equals the hom of squareInjectiveLocalComparison for k on the open g inverse V. This is the forward equation before postcomposition with the inverse endpoint comparison.

source.place: Tags 0D5T and 0D5X; normalized-square calculation before the final inverse endpoint cancellation

proof.text: Identify the right-adjoint square mate with the normalized direct-image composition square and apply the normalized pasted-unit equation to the integer extension of J.

Evaluate the resulting unit equation on local sections. The universal Leray factorization and inverse-open comparison identify the evaluated composite with the raw endpoint comparison for k on g inverse V.
Use the commuting-square equality h to identify v inverse of f inverse V with k inverse of g inverse V; associativity gives the displayed forward equation.

from.place: Forward half of the normalized square cancellation

lean.statement:
theorem squareSectionUnit_forward {X S Z T : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (k : Z ⟶ T) (g : T ⟶ S) (v : Z ⟶ X) (h : v ≫ f = k ≫ g)
    (G : Z.Modules) (J : InjectiveResolution G) (q : ℕ) (V : S.Opens) :
    let U := f ⁻¹ᵁ V
    let t := (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage v.toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerivedFunctorUnitQ
       J.cochainComplex ≫
        (schemeDerivedDirectImage v).map (inv (DerivedCategory.Q.map J.ι'))
    directImageSectionUnitAt f (q : ℤ) V
        (((pushforward v).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj J.cochainComplex) ≫
      ((RingedSpace.localHypercohomologyPresheaf S.toRingedSpace (q : ℤ)).map
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).map t ≫
          (derivedSquareRightComparison f k g v h).hom.app
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
              (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G))).app (op V) ≫
      (RingedSpace.topEdgeLocalLeray g.toLRSHom.toShHom (q : ℤ)
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage k).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G))).hom.app (op V) ≫
      (squareInverseOpenComparison g (q : ℤ)
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage k).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G))).hom.app (op V) =
      (squareInjectiveLocalComparison k G q (g ⁻¹ᵁ V) J (v ⁻¹ᵁ U) (by
        rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, h])).hom
